project.name: PatientTriage.ai
project.summary: Explainable, safety-biased clinical decision-support triage system with dynamic deterioration tracking, active VOI questioning, FHIR v4 ingestion, neurosymbolic SLM core, and regulatory audit trail.

app.label: Streamlit Clinical HUD
app.summary: Interactive 3-workstation clinical dashboard: Intake/Scorer, Waiting Room Radar, and Audit/Override Log.

triage.api.fhir.label: FastAPI FHIR v4 Ingestion Gateway
triage.api.fhir.summary: RESTful HL7 FHIR v4 listener (/Observation, /Patient, /Bundle) with RiskAssessment resource export.

triage.models.label: Clinical Data Contracts (v2)
triage.models.summary: Pydantic v2 schemas: PatientRecord (with medications, allergies, vitals_history), Vitals, AgeCategory, ESILevel, TriageResult.

triage.rules.label: Physiological & Medication Red-Lines (v2)
triage.rules.summary: Age-stratified deterministic vital thresholds (PEWS, NEWS2, qSOFA) & high-risk medication danger alerts.

triage.engine.label: Base & Algorithmic Triage Engine
triage.engine.summary: Abstract BaseTriageEngine contract, deterministic AlgorithmicTriageEngine core, and neurosymbolic LLMTriageEngine.

triage.voi.label: Expanded Active VOI Engine (10 Rules)
triage.voi.summary: Entropy-reducing clinical follow-up question bank across 10 acute emergency presentation categories.

triage.queue.label: Dynamic Queue & Deterioration Radar (SQLite WAL)
triage.queue.summary: Safe wait-time degradation, vital velocity tracking (Delta-SBP/HR/SpO2), breach alerts, and concurrent SQLite WAL persistence.

triage.audit.label: HIPAA De-Identified Audit Trail
triage.audit.summary: Append-only audit ledger recording AI suggestions, VOI Q&A, and clinician overrides with SHA-256 pseudonymization at rest.

triage.cohort.label: 20-Patient Multi-Age Benchmark Cohort
triage.cohort.summary: Synthetic test patients across pediatric, adult, and geriatric clinical presentations with medications & serial vitals.

triage.facility.label: Declarative Facility Profile Engine
triage.facility.summary: Loads YAML facility profiles (Level 1 Trauma vs Rural Access) for dynamic threshold and resource adaptation.

dec.001.label: DEC-001: Pydantic v2 Schema Contracts
dec.001.summary: Enforces strict boundary validation and zero-copy JSON serialization.

dec.002.label: DEC-002: Declarative Rule Registry
dec.002.summary: Isolates physiological red-line thresholds from engine orchestration mechanics.

dec.003.label: DEC-003: Pluggable Repository Pattern
dec.003.summary: Supports in-memory dev execution and production Redis/NATS/SQL queue/audit backends.

dec.004.label: DEC-004: Graded History & Medication Profiling
dec.004.summary: Scores continuous history completeness and flags high-risk medication categories.

dec.005.label: DEC-005: Multi-System VOI Bank (10 Rules)
dec.005.summary: Expands to 10 acute clinical syndrome triggers and reciprocal entropy reduction.

dec.006.label: DEC-006: HIPAA Safe Harbor Pseudonymization
dec.006.summary: Deterministic SHA-256 tokenization (PT-HASH8) of patient identities in audit storage at rest.

dec.007.label: DEC-007: Vital Sign Velocity Tracking
dec.007.summary: Parametric velocity scoring over serial vitals history to catch rapid decompensation before breach.

dec.008.label: DEC-008: Future Horizon Distributed & SLM Architecture
dec.008.summary: FastAPI FHIR v4, NATS JetStream mesh, fine-tunable local clinical SLM (Gemma-2-2B/Qwen2.5-1.5B), and YAML profiler.

dec.009.label: DEC-009: Web & Live Hosting Strategy
dec.009.summary: Streamlit Community Cloud / HuggingFace public live links and on-prem Docker edge appliance recipes.

dec.010.label: DEC-010: Embedded FastAPI HL7 FHIR v4 Adapter
dec.010.summary: Direct ingestion of Observation/Patient/Bundle resources and RiskAssessment export.

dec.011.label: DEC-011: SQLite WAL Persistent Queue Repository
dec.011.summary: Multi-client concurrency without external database dependencies via SQLite WAL.

dec.012.label: DEC-012: Hybrid Neurosymbolic SLM Core
dec.012.summary: SLM free-text entity extraction with deterministic physiological red-line veto stops.

dec.013.label: DEC-013: Declarative YAML Facility Profile Engine
dec.013.summary: YAML-driven configuration of thresholds, resource criteria, and transfer protocols.

metric.confidence.label: Graded Confidence Formula (0.0–1.0)
metric.confidence.summary: 1.0 - P(data) - P(vitals) - P(ambiguity) - P(age_risk). Triggers VOI when < 0.70.

metric.priority_score.label: Dynamic Priority & Velocity Score
metric.priority_score.summary: (6 - ESI)*100 + (WaitTime / SafeThreshold)*50 + Delta Vitals Velocity + Pain.

facts.fact: Evaluation latency SLA is strictly under 50ms (deterministic core runs in ~0.9ms in v1/v2).
Asymmetric loss: Under-triage (ESI 1/2 assigned to 3/4) is 10x worse than over-triage.
Physiological red-lines and medication danger alerts ALWAYS hold veto authority over SLM candidate scores.
Active VOI questions trigger whenever epistemic confidence falls below 70%.
Patient identity in audit storage at rest is pseudonymized with deterministic SHA-256 hashing for HIPAA compliance.
